project_type: Vanilla ES-module Node.js + browser app; plain JSON knowledge base
build_system: No transpilation. Scripts run directly with Node. `package.json` scripts: `test`, `validate-data`, `bench`, `metrics`, `data-quality`, `serve`. All commands from project root.
test_framework: node:test (built-in, Node 22). Command: `node --test "tests/*.test.js"` from project root `c:\Users\spabbisetty\OneDrive - Infor\Desktop\genomex\GenomeX---Final-Year-Project`.
verification_instructions: 1. From project root run: `node --test "tests/*.test.js"` — all tests must pass. 2. Run: `npm run validate-data` — must exit 0 with no errors. 3. Confirm test count has increased by the number of new reference cases added.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that get checked in. Large data in `data_raw/` is excluded from git.
environment_constraints: Windows machine. CRITICAL PRE-CONDITION: `tests/helpers.js` uses `new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname` which returns `/C:/...` on Windows, doubling the drive letter when joined by path.join. Fix FIRST: `import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; export const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));`. Do NOT run npm install. jsdom is available (already in node_modules via devDependencies). Do not restart any server.
contribution_requirements: Every new rule must: (1) cite a real G:PA... annotation ID present in data/guidelines/index.json; (2) have a reference test case in tests/fixtures/reference_cases.js; (3) NOT invent dosing numbers, interactions, evidence levels, or citations; (4) pass dataset schema validation (no errors from buildDataset). Status 'verified' requires at least one evidence entry whose type is not 'secondary_summary'; G:PA* entries have type 'guideline_annotation' and satisfy this. No numeric safety score anywhere.
key_patterns: Rules live in data/rules/pgx.json (array under 'rules' key). Schema enforced by engine/dataset.js buildDataset(). Required fields: id, version, status, module, drug, condition, action, headline, rationale. Optional: requires{}, onUnmetContext, strength, mechanism, monitoring, limitations[], evidence[], evidenceLevel (must be null), alternatives{supported,text,evidence[]}. blocking (boolean). Condition types: 'pgx' (single gene: gene+phenotypeIn[]), 'pgx_all' (multiple genes: all[]). Gene IDs and phenotype values must match data/genes.json exactly. Drug IDs must match data/drugs.json exactly. Evidence IDs must be in data/evidence.json (E-* format) or be G:PA... IDs in data/guidelines/index.json. Seven categories: avoid > modify > conditional > monitor > needs_info > informational > no_flag. RULE_STATUSES: verified, verified_secondary, citation_pending.
directory_structure: engine/ = pure rule engine (dataset.js, evaluators.js, constants.js, index.js); data/ = knowledge base (rules/*.json, guidelines/index.json, evidence.json, drugs.json, genes.json, sources.json, adverse/, tggates/); tests/ = (engine.test.js, data.test.js, ui.test.js, helpers.js, fixtures/reference_cases.js); scripts/ = ingest/verify; frontend/ = UI; research/ = legacy ML (not touched); docs/ = audit docs; genomex-final/ = final output folder (api/, docs/, ml-package/, paper/, rule-coverage/); .agents/tasks/ = workflow artifacts (this directory)
output_location_rule: Rule JSON files MUST stay in data/rules/ (engine requirement). Reference cases MUST stay in tests/fixtures/reference_cases.js. Documentation and reports: write RULE_COVERAGE_ADDITIONS.md to BOTH docs/ AND genomex-final/rule-coverage/. Any other documentation or reports produced in this stream go in genomex-final/rule-coverage/.
